newsitem.title: HONG KONG: New World shares rise after results.
newsitem.headline: New World shares rise after results.

text.p: Shares in New World Development Co Ltd, which on Tuesday posted a 29.16 percent rise in interim net profits to December 31, rose to an intraday high of HK$44.10 in afternoon trade before edging back.
The shares stood at HK$43.30 in late afternoon, up HK$0.40 on the day.
New World reported interim net profit of HK$2.196 billion for the six months to December 31, compared with a HK$1.7 billion profit for the previous corresponding period.
It reported no exceptional items, against a HK$1.114 billion exceptional gain in the previous corresponding period.
Kerry Wong, who follows the company for Lippo Securities, said the net profit was in line with expectations.
Analysts on Monday forecast interim net profits of HK$2.2 billion to HK$2.3 billion.
